/**
 * @file tokens/layout/space.js
 * @description Fibonacci spacing scale (unitless — use with to-rem() in SCSS
 * or rem in JS).
 */

/**
 * Fibonacci spacing scale (unitless. Sole declaration site — consumers import members
 * from this frozen map rather than re-declaring the literals
 * (zero-hardcoding rule).
 */
export const SPACE = Object.freeze({
  NONE: 0,
  HAIRLINE: 1,
  PIXEL: 1,
  '2XS': 2,
  XS: 3,
  SM: 5,
  MD: 8,
  LG: 13,
  XL: 21,
  '2XL': 34,
  '3XL': 55,
  '4XL': 89,
  '5XL': 144,
  '6XL': 233,
  '7XL': 377,
  '8XL': 610,
  '9XL': 987,
})
